description: Sites d'élimination de la neige is a dataset listed in Données Québec open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Ville de Montréal. Ensemble de données contenant la liste et la localisation des sites d'élimination de la neige utilisés par la Ville de Montréal pendant les périodes de chargement de la neige, incluant des informations sur chaque site. Les ensembles sur les secteurs de déneigement, les contrats et transactions sont également disponibles sur le portail. Coverage: Québec. The portal files it under the publisher Ville de Montréal. Its tags are Chargement, Déneigement, Dépôt, Neige, Opération. It offers 30 resource(s) in CSV, GEOJSON, JSON, SHP, ZIP. The portal shows 2026-09-28 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Attribution (CC-BY 4.0). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-quebec-portal.
